name: Hotel Maximillian
beschreibung: The Hotel Maximillian in Innsbruck is located in the Altstadt near the Goldenes Dachl. Despite its central location, it is situated on a quiet street. The surroundings are characterized by the Nordkette and the Inntal, which serve as destinations for hiking. In winter, the Patscherkofel and Axamer Lizum ski areas can be reached by public transport. The property has a restaurant and a bar. A wellness area with sauna and steam bath is available. The rooms are modernly furnished. Guests use the hotel as a starting point for city explorations and activities in the nearby mountains.
